text:
Maria (AE): Hey team — heads up on a new Enterprise POC with GenWave. They want a 30-day POC, dedicated capacity, and an order form signed before we spin up. Need DPA + HSM/KMS attestation, net45, and a request for added SLAs.
Daphne (Solutions): Thanks Maria. Do we have the expected QPS and model families they want to test? That'll affect Dedicated sizing and whether we can offer burst.
Maria (AE): Chris from GenWave shared this: 
`QPS: 50 steady, 200 spikes`, models: `gptx-8b-quantized`, seq length ~ 1024. Also they asked for KMS with customer-managed keys.
Daphne (Solutions): OK that fits our Dedicated profile but will need a KMS integration addendum. I'll draft the recommended capacity and a cost estimate.
Leo (Legal): Adding legal — we'll need their counterparty name for the MSA and to know if they require countersignature or DocuSign routing to multiple signers. Also, what DPA modifications are they asking for?
Maria (AE): They want the DPA to include EU SCCs and a subsection for HSM key custody (they called it 'HSM attestation'). They also want no subprocessing without notice.
Leo (Legal): Hmm. HSM attestation language is uncommon — ask them to provide the specific clause they need. We can support customer-managed KMS but attestation language will be reviewed by security. Also if they require SCCs, finance/legal will want to see billing entity and invoicing address for tax.
Sam (Finance): On net45: we can approve for Enterprise but need procurement contact and PO number pattern. Also FYI larger commits require a revenue commit form. Send PO flow and if they want multiple invoices per month, note that affects GL posting.
Chris (Customer): @Maria (AE) - GenWave procurement contact is elena.procure@gwave.com. Billing entity is GenWave, Inc. We can provide a sample PO. We want the signed order form to include: start date, seat count, committed tokens, and SLA targets.
Maria (AE): Sharing our draft order form link: https://redwood.internal/docs/templates/orderform-enterprise-v2.pdf (internal). Can Legal confirm which fields we should lock vs. editable by sales?
Leo (Legal): Lock: pricing table, term, MSA reference. Editable: billing contact, PO number, start date (within reason). For SCCs/DPA changes, send proposed redlines.
security-bot: Security questionnaire ticket created: SECQ-8921, assigned to Daphne and Leo. Link: https://redwood.internal/secq/SECQ-8921
Daphne (Solutions): I'll run the questionnaire for KMS/HSM items. Quick checklist for security team: key control model, HSM vendor, attestation level (self-attest vs. 3rd party), and whether they need key escrow.
Maria (AE): They said HSM vendor is Thales; they want 3rd-party attestation and proof of KMS integration with our Dedicated nodes.
Leo (Legal): Send those specifics into SECQ ticket. If they insist on a 3rd-party attestation, that'll require a SOC2-type artifact or an HSM attestation we may not hold — security will confirm.
Sam (Finance): Also confirm currency and tax residency. If they're EU invoicing, we need VAT info.
Chris (Customer): VAT ID: EU-GW-44321. Currency: USD.
Daphne (Solutions): I'll map required infra changes; likely need KMS keywrap support + customer key provisioning doc. If Legal OKs DPA redlines, we can include a KMS addendum to the order form.
Leo (Legal): Please upload proposed redlines as a single PDF. We prefer tracked changes but a numbered bullet list is fine.
Maria (AE): Copying the ask: 1) DPA with SCCs + no-subprocessor clause, 2) HSM/KMS attestation clause, 3) net45 PO flow, 4) SLA targets in order form. I'll collect the PO and redlines and ping again.
security-bot: SECQ-8921 updated: evidence requested: Thales HSM attestation certificate, integration diagram, and key lifecycle doc. Due in 3 business days.
Sam (Finance): Once redlines + PO are in, I'll validate billing entity and issue billing terms approval. If net45 approved, we'll record payment term exception.
Daphne (Solutions): Estimated time to stand up Dedicated proof-of-concept (after signed OF + keys): 7 business days for capacity + 2 for KMS onboarding.
Maria (AE): Great — I'll coordinate with GenWave procurement. Tagging @Leo (Legal) and @Sam (Finance) to expect redlines and PO by EOD Tue.
Leo (Legal): Thanks — will triage on receipt.
Chris (Customer): Thanks everyone. Will aim to send PO + DPA redlines by Monday EOD. :thumbsup:
